## Description
 &#10;&#9;&#9;15 kW, ~235 kWh. ~200 mi range. &#10;&#9;&#9;Can store 100 kg (or 120L) methanol.&#10;&#9;&#9;empty tank mass: 15 kg.&#10;&#9;&#9;need 5 kg aerogel or foam for insulation to prevent ice/freeze on exterior.&#10;&#9;&#9;need a 5 kg fuel pre-heater to bring -40C to 200 C for RMFC. &#10;&#9;&#9;IRMFC Consumption: ~0.8–0.9 L/(kW·h) → ~12–13.5 L/hour (or ~10–11 kg/hour).&#10;&#9;
